evals.name: core-only-quick-check
evals.prompt: I just tweaked the SGR parsing in src/AnsiSgr.cpp. Can you quickly confirm the core logic still compiles and the self-test passes? I don't need the full plugin DLL right now, just a fast sanity check.
evals.expected_output: Uses the fast vcvars-free clang++ core build (not a full MSVC/_build.bat DLL build), runs the host self-test, and reports 'OK: all core tests passed'. Avoids the bare `cmake --build` missing-stdlib-header failure.

assertions.text: Used the clang++ host build (not the full _build.bat / MSVC DLL build) for a core-only change
Ran the host self-test and it reported 'OK: all core tests passed'
Did not get stuck on the bare `cmake --build` missing-standard-header (vcvars) error
Included the AI core sources (AiJson.cpp, AiClient.cpp) so the link step succeeded

evals.name: full-dll-build-and-test
evals.prompt: Build the plugin DLL and run the whole test suite so I know everything's green before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Builds the DLL via _build.bat (vcvars + Ninja), sees BUILD_DONE / ANSI_COLOR_TEXT.dll, then runs ctest and reports the tests passing. Does not get stuck on a bare `cmake --build` that fails for lack of the vcvars environment.

assertions.text: Built via _build.bat or an explicitly vcvars-wrapped MSVC build, not a bare `cmake --build`
Ran ctest and reported the host self-test passing
